title: The Save Pelé Never Forgot
coreQuestion: Why is Gordon Banks's save from Pelé in 1970 still studied?

facts.source: Brazil at the 1970 FIFA World Cup
facts.claim: Pelé nearly scored with a header against England that was spectacularly saved by Gordon Banks.
Pelé and numerous journalists and pundits later described the save as the greatest in the game's history.

facts.source: Brazil at the 1970 FIFA World Cup
facts.claim: Jairzinho scored the only goal of the match against England.
Brazil won the final 4–1 against Italy.

narration.text: Pelé's header looked like a goal. Then it wasn't.
The 1970 World Cup. Brazil against England.
Pelé met the cross with a header.
Gordon Banks got across and kept it out.
Pelé and many pundits later called it the greatest save in the game's history.
And they went on to win the final against Italy. Every goal has a story.
